_compatNote: Firefox runs background/index.js as an MV3 event page (non-persistent scripts entry; modules unsupported, so the entry ships as a classic script). Firefox temporarily registers content/modal.js for the clicked tab origin and reloads once because scripting.executeScript does not retain a content-script message listener; Chromium injects it directly. No offscreen document: offscreen is Chromium-only and unnecessary for a source collector.
